items.title: Fiverr — async freelance storefront (global)
items.summary: Sell fixed-scope gigs (writing, design, audio) with chat delivery; minimize live calls by stating async-first in your gig description.

items.title: Upwork — EU + international clients (proposal-based)
items.summary: Remote project marketplace; filter for async-friendly roles and skip interviews that require phone if that is a hard constraint.

items.title: Prolific / survey panels — low social friction (patchy income)
items.summary: Academic studies; income is inconsistent but can validate payout workflows and build routine. Read each study's requirements.

items.title: Gumroad / Lemon Squeezy — digital products (EU-friendly)
items.summary: Sell templates, presets, guides. Works with async marketing (SEO, short-form video) instead of sales calls.

items.title: Apple App Store / Google Play — utility micro-SaaS path (longer cycle)
items.summary: Mobile utilities can monetize without meetings; requires build + store compliance. Pair with async support via email.

items.title: TeacherPayTeachers / Etsy digital — if you teach or template well
items.summary: Sell printable / lesson resources; customer contact mostly async.

items.title: NL: FreelanceFactuur / KVK guidance — keep taxes clean
items.summary: Register business structure when revenue justifies it; reduces personal risk as income scales.
